physical_subject: How can a moving random process have a stationary distribution?
relationship: For A-to-B probability1/4 and B-to-A probability1/2, the stationary probabilities are2/3and1/3; the update p_next=1/2+p/4 shrinks the gap from2/3byonequarter.
operation: Distinguish one possible dot path from probability mass; exchange equal sixths and show contraction of the gap from the stationary probability.
closest_prior: Random-walk diffusion, Polya urn, stationary waves and reservoir sampling
substantive_difference: A finite two-state Markov stationary distribution and explicit contraction, rather than spatial RMS spreading, reinforced random sampling, wave interference or reservoir selection.
